Jogging fun with a dog Do you like jogging with your dog? Then you are optimally equipped for jogging, walking, canicross or for a long walk with our jogging belt with lead. The belly bag with jogging lead allows hands-free jogging and is therefore your optimal companion - keys, snacks, drinks and even dog dirt bags can find a place in the belly belt. The integrated lead has a shock absorber that cushions sudden jerky pulls of the dog. The safety feature allows for a quick release of the lead. Even in rainy or bad weather, the belly belt with lead is just right for every athlete - water-repellent material and waterproof zips prevent water from entering the pockets. In the dark or in poor visibility, reflective elements on the bag and lead draw attention to runners and their pets. The wide, ergonomic cut provides comfort when worn, and the inserts in the back and belly areas prevent excessive sweating. On your mark, get set, go!
